confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not from live listings or menus. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately confident. Cocktail and wine_glass are set at roughly 2x the beer anchor because direct knowledge is weak. Hostel and hotel anchors are the least certain. The FX value (0.6955, 2026-10-15) came from a search summary attributed to the RBA exchange-rates page; I did not open that page to verify it, and a third-party site showed a slightly different figure for 2026-10-16, which I did not use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is general knowledge of mid-sized Andean capitals in Latin America that use the US dollar, with high-altitude tourism demand. Prices are set between budget and mid-range levels typical of Quito's Old Town and New Town areas.
